title: Structural characterization the LlaI anti-phage defense system reveals insights into the evolution of nucleotide specificity and the organization of DNA binding in McrBC restriction complexes
authors: Anthony Q Bui; Christopher J Hosford; Yiming Niu; Emerson Santiago; David Moraga; Mateusz M Wagner; Joshua S Chappie
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构和计算建模研究LlaI抗噬菌体防御系统中DNA结合模块与AAA+马达的组装及DNA结合机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构与机制研究，方法上以实验结构为主、计算建模为辅，对TF-DNA互作建模有方法借鉴价值。
abstract: Canonical McrBC enzymes are nucleotide-powered, motor-driven endonucleases that bind and cleave modified bacteriophage DNA. Non-canonical McrBC homologs like LlaI and BsuMI are distinguished by a unique three-gene organization and the ability to target DNA site-specifically. Here, we report the atomic-resolution crystal structures of the DNA-binding module LlaI.R1 and AAA+ motor LlaI.R2 from the Lactococcus lactis LlaI anti-phage defense system. The crystallized LlaI.R2 hexamer traps two distinct active site conformations that correlate to different states of the nucleotide hydrolysis cycle and reveal that the organization of the critical catalytic machinery present in canonical McrB homologs is also conserved in non-canonical R2 proteins. Although canonical McrB homologs are strictly GTP-specific, we find that the R2 proteins from LlaI and BsuMI do not discriminate between different nucleotides, even when in complex with their respective R1 partners. Using mutagenesis, we define surfaces on the LlaI.R1 structure that are critical for DNA-binding and interaction with LlaI.R2. These observations support computational modelling of the assembled LlaI restriction system bound to DNA. Together, our data provide new insights into the evolution of nucleotide specificity in McrBC restriction complexes and the molecular mechanisms governing McrBC-catalyzed DNA translocation and cleavage.
abstract_zh: 典型的McrBC酶是核苷酸驱动的、马达驱动的核酸内切酶，能够结合并切割修饰的噬菌体DNA。非典型的McrBC同源物，如LlaI和BsuMI，以其独特的三基因组织和位点特异性靶向DNA的能力而著称。在此，我们报告了来自乳酸乳球菌（Lactococcus lactis）LlaI抗噬菌体防御系统的DNA结合模块LlaI.R1和AAA+马达LlaI.R2的原子分辨率晶体结构。结晶的LlaI.R2六聚体捕获了两种不同的活性位点构象，这些构象与核苷酸水解循环的不同状态相关，并揭示了典型McrB同源物中存在的关键催化机制的组织在非典型R2蛋白中也得以保留。尽管典型的McrB同源物严格具有GTP特异性，但我们发现来自LlaI和BsuMI的R2蛋白不区分不同核苷酸，即使在与各自R1伙伴形成复合物时也是如此。通过诱变，我们定义了LlaI.R1结构上对DNA结合及与LlaI.R2相互作用至关重要的表面。这些观察结果支持了组装后的LlaI限制系统与DNA结合的计算机建模。综合来看，我们的数据为McrBC限制复合物中核苷酸特异性的进化以及McrBC催化的DNA易位和切割的分子机制提供了新见解。
